items.title: Bud Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-28
items.q: I was a whippin' Peter's punch on the bass pedal.

ctx.x: Took up the Juice Hop, then from Juice Hop and went to Harmonica. Mm-hmm. And from Harmonica I went to guitar. From guitar I went to manna. From manna I went to violin. From violin I went to tuba. Then I went to bass pedal. I was a whippin' Peter's punch on the bass pedal. I used to slap him. Like nobody's business.
How would you hold your hand when you did that? Left handed.
